meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 的某个群组搭一套持久化 wiki 知识库:建 wiki/ 和 sources/ 目录、初始 index.md 与 log.md、容器里的 wiki 技能,并在该群 CLAUDE.md 中加入 wiki 段落;之后 Claude 按摄录、查询、检查来维护它。
howto.when: 当你说出「add wiki」「wiki」「knowledge base」等词、想给某个 NanoClaw 群组加知识库时触发;它基于 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 模式。

say.text: 给这个群加一个 wiki 知识库
say.note: 先带你读模式,再问放在哪个群

say.text: 把这份 PDF 收进 wiki
say.note: 一次只处理一个文件,读完再更新页面

say.text: 给 wiki 安排每周健康检查
say.note: 可配置每周或每月的定时 lint

howto.what_en: Adds a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group: creates wiki/ and sources/ folders, index.md and log.md, a container wiki skill, and a wiki section in the group's CLAUDE.md, then maintains it via ingest, query and lint.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base" and similar phrases when you want a wiki set up for a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.

say_en.text: Add a wiki knowledge base to this group
say_en.note: Reads the pattern first, then asks which group

say_en.text: Ingest this PDF into the wiki
say_en.note: Processes one file at a time, updating pages

say_en.text: Set up a weekly wiki health check
say_en.note: Schedules a weekly or monthly lint task
